Name: Picnic Rugs for Content Patcher
Author: QuillSnow
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49938/49938-1785445087-366814341.png[/img][/center]
[center][Image Text: Features][/center]
[center][/center]
[left]This mod converts [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11107]Skellady's Picnic Rugs[/url] from Alternative Textures to Content Patcher. In addition to the original 10 variants of Penny's picnic event rug, you can also now place 10 new clutter-free variants, which can be rotated vertically. The rugs can be found in the new Picnic Rug Catalogue, which can be purchased from Robin for 5000g. The price of the catalogue can be changed to your preference in the mod config. Alternatively, you can spawn them in using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url], by searching for the term "Quillex".[/left]
[left][/left]
[left]The rugs can be placed outdoors if you have [url=https://github.com/Sparky56p/AnythingAnywhere]Anything Anywhere[/url] installed.[/left]
[left][/left]
[left][color=#d5a6bd][b]CONFIG OPTIONS[/b][/color][/left]
[list=1]
[*]Catalogue Price: Defaults to 5000. You can change it to whatever value you like![/*]
[*]ExcludeFromVanillaCatalogue: Defaults to false. Toggle this to determine whether or not the rugs show up in the vanilla furniture catalogue.[/*]
[/list][center][/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49938/49938-1785445128-27243897.png[/img][/center]
[center][Image Text: Requirements][/center]
[center][/center]
[left]To use this mod, you need to have the following installed:[/left]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]. The mod will not load without this.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628]Calcifer[/url]. Without this, you cannot access the custom catalogue.[/*]
[/list]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49938/49938-1785445159-1118790976.png[/img][/center]
[center][Image Text: Installation][/center]
[center][/center]
[left][list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] if you haven't already.[/*]
[*]Install [i]both[/i] dependencies for the mod.[/*]
[*]Download the latest release of the picnic rugs from the [i]Files[/i] tab, and unzip it into your mod's folder.[/*]
[/list]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49938/49938-1785445183-552141146.png[/img][/center]

[center][/center]
[list=1]
[*]The original picnic rug is a vanilla game asset, drawn by ConcernedApe, and was recoloured by Skellady. [/*]

[/list]
